tldr: Azure AI Gateway is now generally available, with 10,000 monthly requests free but paid billing beginning January 1, 2027; private networking is still in preview.
Anthropic’s Claude Ship can review pull requests, make fixes, and approve changes within team policy, so agent access and approval controls deserve a closer look.

top.title: Azure AI Gateway is generally available as a standalone service
top.summary: Microsoft made Azure AI Gateway generally available for governing access to models and MCP tools across providers. Each gateway includes 10,000 requests per month free; paid billing starts January 1, 2027, while private networking remains in preview.
top.why: Evaluate it for cross-provider governance, but include post-January billing in your cost model and check whether the private-networking preview blocks your deployment design.

top.title: Anthropic launches Claude Ship to manage pull requests under team policy
top.summary: Claude Ship is a set of agents on Claude Team and Enterprise that can review GitHub pull requests, push fixes, and approve changes allowed by a team's policy.
top.why: If you pilot it, decide which repositories and permissions agents may use, since the tool can both modify code and approve changes.

also.title: AWS Nitro Sandboxes offer coding agents a place to run generated scripts
also.summary: AWS Nitro Sandboxes are presented as an environment where coding agents can execute scripts they generate.
